stem: A Medicare beneficiary asks what the Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) is designed to accomplish. Which response by the nurse is most accurate?

options.A: It includes a health risk assessment and develops or updates a personalized prevention plan
options.B: It is primarily a comprehensive head-to-toe diagnostic physical examination for new symptoms
options.C: It is limited to obtaining a blood pressure measurement and reviewing prescriptions
options.D: It replaces all separately recommended preventive screening services for the year

rationale: Current CMS guidance states that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit is used to develop or update a personalized prevention plan and includes a health risk assessment. CMS distinguishes the AWV from a routine physical examination. The AWV contains multiple preventive assessment and planning components, and it does not replace other indicated Medicare-covered preventive services. Therefore A is the best answer.
educational_objective: Explain that the Medicare Annual Wellness Visit centers on a health risk assessment and a personalized preventive health plan rather than a routine comprehensive physical examination.
source_document_title: Annual Wellness Visit; Medicare Wellness Visits
source_locator: Medicare Wellness Visits > Quick Start > Annual Wellness Visit: visit to develop or update a personalized prevention plan and perform a health risk assessment; Annual Wellness Visit > First AWV Components: perform an HRA and complete personalized prevention planning/advice/referrals
source_claim_supported: The Medicare AWV includes a health risk assessment and is designed to develop or update a personalized prevention plan; it is distinct from a routine physical examination.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance — Health Promotion/Disease Prevention: provide education about health-promotion recommendations, preventive services, screenings, and age/risk-appropriate health maintenance
blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — adult preventive care / Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
correction_summary: Eliminated the ambiguous generic term 'adult wellness visit' and the mixed USPSTF/CMS source attribution. Rebuilt the item around the precisely defined Medicare Annual Wellness Visit using current 2026 CMS guidance and a single clear preventive-care construct.
audit_findings: A directly matches current CMS AWV guidance. B confuses the AWV with a routine diagnostic physical examination; CMS specifically distinguishes these services. C is incomplete because the AWV includes a structured HRA, measurements and assessments, prevention planning, and counseling/referrals. D overstates AWV scope because Medicare preventive screenings and other services remain separately indicated/covered. One best answer remains without state-law or payer ambiguity because the stem explicitly identifies Medicare AWV. Health Promotion and Maintenance is directly appropriate for preventive-services education.
